# never-distribute.txt - the blocklist for .github/scripts/check-never-distribute.js.
#
# Skills that are NOT licensed for distribution: (1) third-party Vietnamese
# marketing skills, (2) skills whose origin and licence are unknown (blocked until
# a licence is found).
# They must never reach this repo: not as skills/<dir>, not copied into docs, evals
# or fixtures, not credited by their upstream identifiers.
#
# Paths into the repo that could pull them in (all copy from skills/ only):
#   cli/commands/sync-assets.js, cli/commands/skill.js (`agency skill install`),
#   scripts/skill-registry.py (INDEX.md lists whatever is in skills/).
#
# Format, one per line:
#   dir    | <name>    fails if a tracked path has a directory segment equal to <name> below a skills/ segment
#   id     | <text>    fails if ANY tracked file CONTENT contains <text> (case-insensitive)
#   idhash | <sha256>  fails if any lowercase alphanumeric token in tracked file content hashes to it
# Exempt from the content rule: this file.
# Never add an entry to remove a hit; delete the offending files instead.
